title: Generalist Generative Agent: Open-ended design exploration with large language models
task: 开放式概念设计与程序化3D生成
inputData: 文本隐喻/设计任务 + 程序化建模上下文 + 渲染图像与JSON评价信息
contribution: 提出Generalist Generative Agent，以多智能体链路把抽象设计隐喻转化为建筑设计任务、Rhino/Grasshopper程序化建模代码、3D概念模型与视觉评价，探索LLM在开放式早期建筑设计中的生成、执行和自评估能力。
abstract: Architects often use metaphors and conceptual models to work with ambiguity during early-stage design, while conventional computational tools tend to rely on narrowly predefined design spaces. The Generalist Generative Agent investigates whether LLM-based agents can support open-ended architectural exploration by interpreting ambiguous concepts, generating procedural 3D models and evaluating resulting designs.
methodology: The framework contains four agents. A Metaphor Agent generates architectural metaphors; an Interpretation Agent translates them into concrete design implications and tasks; a Modelling Agent generates and iteratively repairs procedural Python/RhinoCommon code executed in Rhino 8 and Grasshopper to create parameterized 3D concept models; and an Evaluation Agent uses GPT-4o vision on Blender-rendered outputs to score metaphor alignment, conceptual strength, geometric complexity, and task adherence. Experiments compare metaphor-only, design-task, and history/few-shot contexts.
results: Across 20 metaphors and 100 design tasks, the study ran 1,100 generation attempts and produced 992 3D models, corresponding to about 90% model-generation success. Across parameter variations, 3,992 valid OBJ/render outputs were produced from 4,960 expected outputs (about 80%). Generation required approximately 18.5 hours and automated evaluation about 11 hours; an architect subsequently selected 137 images as notable designs. The experiment demonstrates scalable procedural generation and automated visual scoring, while the paper still treats expert judgement as necessary for interpreting architectural quality.
taskEn: Open-ended concept design and procedural 3D generation
inputDataEn: Text metaphors/design tasks plus procedural-modeling context and rendered images/JSON evaluation information
operationEvidence: The agent chain generates architectural concepts and executable Rhino/Grasshopper code, runs that code to create and vary 3D models, renders the outputs, and uses GPT-4o vision to score the generated designs against explicit conceptual and geometric criteria.
